cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for the audition results. Your breathing is rather conspicuous; what count are you using?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, four in, six out. Through the nose, please. I'm doing it with you so you can keep the pace.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, but put the number beside each name. Pass me the pen; I'll demonstrate. What's your sister's number? She was very kind last time.

reason: Make A appropriate B's breathing and contact-list strategies as demonstrations of competence, while the final requested support contact exposes borrowing.
